name: Choose the Z-check pairing
title: Pair first, then fill
description: Three Z-checks each meet the logical in four qubits, and the size-two overlap of Z₃ is already a forced edge. Add edges until every highlighted overlap contains a perfect matching, then connect and fill what is left.
hint: One edge may serve several checks: the forced q0–q1 edge already pairs half of Z₀ and half of Z₂. Two more hexagon sides finish all three matchings, and a path through the remaining vertices connects the complex without opening a cycle.
